'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Look what my guys made! The rigs look like a perfect match, but they still need to be tested. If you can beat the local hotshots with them, then it's a good product.}}

==Objectives==
* Locate and neutralize any 5 [[Bosses]] (excluding [[The Goons]], [[The Wedge]] and [[Partisan]]) while using any Goons Edition tactical rig

==Rewards==
* +92,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 340,000 Roubles
** 357,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 391,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 3× [[NPP KlASS Bagariy plate carrier (EMR)]]
* Unlocks Laminate [[Hideout]] floor style
{{quote|So, how was it? No stiffness, no tearing? Then maybe I can increase the price a bit... Oh, right, here's your reward, you're a life saver!}}
